text:
Maria G: quick FYI — after the RBAC rollout to tighten keystore roles in eu-west, we're seeing a spike in internal east-west mTLS handshakes failing. looks like KMS unwrap denied for a subset of proxies. :grimacing:
Ajay P: saw the alert too, digging into logs now. is this the 1.2.0 RBAC change from yesterday?
Maria G: yes, the role scoping patch. rollout started at ~08:10 UTC. first errors around 08:17.
Lucas T: throwing logs here — partial stack from proxy: ```ERROR 2026-03-22T08:18:22Z handshake failed: keystore unwrap: kms error=AccessDeniedException principal=service-proxy-eu-west role=keystore-reader```
Ajay P: that AccessDenied matches the new iam condition on kms:Decrypt where resource tag must include team=platform. proxies don't have that tag.
Security Eng: confirmed — audit logs show principal service-proxy-eu-west attempted Decrypt, denied by IAM policy version v3.0. We should not grant wide Decrypt.
Maria G: agreed. immediate mitigation options? rollback RBAC change? quick tag proxies?
Lucas T: safest is rollback the RBAC patch for eu-west (fast) and then do a targeted fix. tagging thousands of ephemeral proxies is messy.
Ajay P: I can roll back the patch on the rotator. ETA ~15m if no blockers.
SRE Bot: deploy rollback job queued by @Ajay P — job id deploy-177888-rollback-1. status: in_progress
Maria G: while rollback happens, can we add an audit alert to catch any other regions where role mismatch would deny Decrypt (to avoid a repeat)?
Security Eng: yes — creating an AuditRule: ```rule: kms.decrypt.denied if principal.service contains "proxy" and region in [eu-west, ap-south] actions: notify #eng-security, create ticket```
Ajay P: rollback completed — can folks confirm handshake rates? logs show handshake success ratio back to normal for affected proxies.
Lucas T: confirming sample: previously 23% failed handshakes -> now 0.8% within same 10m window.
Maria G: great. postmortem items: 1) make RBAC rollout gate include keystore unwrap smoke test 2) ensure proxy provisioning tags align with IAM conditions 3) add canary policy that rejects Decrypt in staging first
Security Eng: adding to incident board and tagging owners. also recommend an automation: when RBAC changes reference kms:Decrypt, run a dry-run audit across all principals that will be affected and list denied principals.
Ajay P: also flagged that some older proxies (image v1.7) don't push the right instance metadata. we need to patch the bootstrap to emit team tags.
Lucas T: I'll open a PR for metadata agent bump. reference: repo infra/provisioning#452
Maria G: TL;DR: rollback fixed outage. follow-ups assigned. small action now: Security Eng, can you run the dry-run audit before next RBAC rollout?
Security Eng: yes — running dry-run tomorrow 09:00 UTC and will share results in this thread. will include KMS audit logs snippet and the list of impacted principals. :white_check_mark:
Maria G: thanks everyone, closing the alert and moving to postmortem. remember to annotate the RBAC change with this incident id inc-177888.
SRE Bot: alert closed by @Maria G — incident inc-177888 archived to incidents board.
